description: Apple Maps from the Mac. Give one of: query (places by name or kind, like "coffee" or "Sutter Health", near near: an address, lat,lon, or here for the Mac; default the Mac), to (directions and travel time from from, default here, by mode: driving (default), walking, or transit (time only); optionally depart_at or arrive_by), or address (its coordinates; or lat,lon for its address). Dates: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the Mac's time zone (optionally with Z or ±HH:MM).

address.description: An address to find, or lat,lon to name

limit.description: At most this many places (default 10, up to 25)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

near.description: Where to look: an address, lat,lon, or here; only places within 50 km of it come back

to.description: Where to go: an address, lat,lon, or here

name: maps_find
title: Search Maps
